metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Node.js (no dependencies) RS274/NGC G-code simulator CLI in `output/`, runnable as:

- `node output/main.js --input <gcode_file> --output <result_file> [other flags]`

Key files:
- `output/main.js` (entry point + execution engine + trace generation)
- `output/parser.js` / `output/expr.js` (block parsing + RS274-style numeric/expression evaluation)
- `output/file_formats.js` (RS274 tool table + parameter file read/write per the spec sections referenced)
- `output/machine.js` (machine state model + JSON serialization)
- `output/trace.js` (initial snapshot + delta trace emission)
- `output/geometry.js` (timing + linear/arc geometry helpers)

It supports the required flags (including `--trace-output` with exactly one stepping mode), writes the result JSON on both success and error, writes the trace file on both success and error, and writes `--parameter-output` only on success.
